note: Lightweight backlog of articles discovered (primarily from the Snacks Weekly on Data Science podcast's episodes) but not yet written up as full deep-dive entries. The daily refresh Routine upgrades stubs to full entries over time: it deep-summarises the top items here, writes them into articles/ + index.json, and removes them from this file. Episode enumeration is best-effort via web search because the podcast's full feed/list is egress-blocked in this environment (~45 of 101 episodes recovered so far). URLs are the underlying company article where known; null means the deepening step should locate it.

stubs.title: Robust A/B Decisions
stubs.hook: An ambiguity-averse decision rule for deploying A/B test winners, validated on 552 real ad experiments, that reportedly beats naive t-test-based deployment.

stubs.title: The Recall Ceiling of LLM Recommendation Reranking
stubs.hook: Shows the standard 'oracle' evaluation protocol for LLM rerankers overestimates realistic NDCG@10 by 92-95% because real upstream retrieval only recovers 2-19% of relevant items at K=100 -- a companion evaluation-rigor finding to the tie-handling audit already in the bank.

stubs.title: OneTrans-V2: Unifying Retrieval, Pre-rank, and Fine-rank with One Transformer in Industrial Recommender
stubs.hook: Collapses the classic multi-stage retrieval/pre-rank/fine-rank recommender pipeline into a single transformer, reporting +9.74% GMV in production.

stubs.company: Andrew Gelman (Statistical Modeling, Causal Inference, and Social Science)
stubs.title: It's fine to use computer-generated survey responses -- if you don't care about the data anyway
stubs.hook: A critique of substituting LLM-generated respondents for real survey data, arguing junk methodology stays junk no matter what fills in the answers.

stubs.title: Personal data classification at scale
stubs.hook: Classifying and protecting personal data across a large data estate.

stubs.title: Covariate selection in causal inference
stubs.hook: Choosing covariates well to get unbiased causal estimates.

stubs.title: Generative AI to create new food recipes
stubs.hook: Using generative models to invent new recipes.

stubs.title: Handling data imbalance in text models with automated augmentation
stubs.hook: Automated augmentation techniques to fix class imbalance in text data.

stubs.title: From One Horizontal Scaling Controller to Many: Evolving Uber's Compute Platform
stubs.hook: Evolving Uber's internal compute platform from a single horizontal-scaling controller to multiple, addressing scaling bottlenecks as workloads (including ML) grew.

stubs.title: Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD): An Open Specification for Agent Discovery
stubs.hook: AWS backs an open cross-environment discovery standard (ARD) as a federation layer over its own Agent Registry for governing AI agents, tools, and skills at scale.

stubs.title: High-Throughput Structure Prediction with BioNeMo Inference Runtime
stubs.hook: Accelerates biomolecular structure prediction at proteome scale through an optimized inference pipeline, illustrating domain-specialized inference-runtime design.

stubs.title: Accelerating Coupang's AI Journey with LLMs
stubs.hook: Coupang engineering's account of scaling LLM adoption across search, ads, catalog, and recommendations, moving from classical ML to LLM-driven workflows.

stubs.title: Grab Bench: Evaluating AI on Grab-shaped production work
stubs.hook: Internal agent/model evaluation harness with task-specific scoring, hidden test cases, and row-level failure taxonomy — built because public leaderboards miss the quiet production failures that matter.

stubs.title: Evaluate Any Agent Framework with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Evaluations
stubs.hook: Decouples agent evaluation from the agent framework by scoring any agent that emits OpenTelemetry telemetry (LangGraph, LlamaIndex, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, Claude Agent SDK, Strands).

stubs.title: Engineering AI 'coworkers' that live in Slack
stubs.hook: Software you @mention in Slack like a coworker that remembers past discussions, follows up on dropped threads, and pushes back when asked to do something it shouldn't.

stubs.title: A Decade of AI Platform at Pinterest
stubs.hook: A retrospective on how Pinterest's internal ML platform evolved over ten years to support its current recommendation and ads systems.

stubs.title: 1,500+ PRs Later: Spotify's Journey with Its Background Coding Agent (Honk)
stubs.hook: The background coding agent whose adoption is the direct driver behind the throughput increase examined in Spotify's later AI-quality-at-velocity post.

stubs.title: From "What Happened?" to "What Will Happen?": Genie + TabPFN for conversational predictive BI
stubs.hook: Fusing Genie as a dynamic feature-engineering layer with TabPFN's zero-training tabular prediction to answer predictive questions inside a BI chat turn.

stubs.title: Adaptive Instructed-Retriever: Frontier-Quality Search at 2x Lower Latency
stubs.hook: A retrieval model that adaptively stops early when confident, combining parallel-retrieval speed with sequential-search quality under strict latency/cost budgets.

stubs.title: Building a File Semantic Analyzer: Guarding Outbound Data at Scale with AI
stubs.hook: An AI-based semantic analyzer that inspects outbound files for sensitive content at scale, beyond what pattern/regex-based DLP tools catch.

stubs.title: Lessons from Building a First-Pass AI PRD Reviewer at Uber
stubs.hook: An LLM-based reviewer that gives product-requirement docs an automated first pass before human review, and what Uber learned making it trustworthy enough to use.

stubs.title: Cart Assistant: Agentic Grocery Shopping on Uber Eats
stubs.hook: An agentic assistant that builds a grocery cart on Uber Eats from a conversational request, in the same product space as Instacart's Clementine.

stubs.title: AI Prototyping Is Changing How We Build Products at Uber
stubs.hook: How AI-assisted prototyping tools changed Uber's internal product-development workflow, from idea to testable prototype.
